Agartala (Tripura) lies on or near the Tropic of Cancer. Visakhapatnam is in Andhra Pradesh, which lies wholly south of the Tropic, while Shimla and Lucknow are in Himachal Pradesh and Uttar Pradesh, which lie wholly north of it.
